QuestInfo.name: Defeat Deo
QuestInfo.0: You've managed to convince #p2100001# somehow. Go report to #p2101010#.
QuestInfo.1: You report that #p2100001# has been convinced. #p2101010# grins, nods, and then suggests that you defeat #r#o3220001##k. Hmm, now he wants you to defeat a monster? Sigh...but don't forget that there is a bounty. That should motivate you a little. \n\n#k#o3220001#  #r#a39541##k
QuestInfo.2: You defeated #o3220001# and told #p2101010#. #p2101010# laughed heartily and said you did well. Huh? Is that it? What happened to the bounty? #p2101010# said the bounty didn't include members of the Sand Bandits. No way!

0.0: You convinced #p2100001#? I'm impressed. No member of the Sand Bandits has been able to win over that stubborn old man... You're incredible. You are the pride and joy of the Sand Bandits.\r\n#L0##b(Er, was it that big of a deal?)#l
0.1: Since you were able to do something no one has been able to do, you'll also defeat #o3220001# for us, won't you?\r\n#L0##b(Hmph, what happened to convincing that old man being half the battle!?)#l
0.2: Now, go and defeat #r1 #o3220001##k for us. It shouldn't be too difficult. Not for you.

yes.0: You want to know where #o3220001# is? Well, I'm not sure. Seeing as how he's the leader of Cactus, wouldn't he be in the #b#Dry Desert##k? I don't think he appears that frequently, so be patient.

no.0: Too much for you? Not something I expected to hear. But, come closer and listen to me... There is a bounty being offered...
